     return {'login_prompt_seen': login,
 'input_box_markers': inp,
             'logged_in_ui': bool(inp) and not login}'''
 new = '''# Claude pane readiness comes from ONE shared
 classifier (claude_readiness): a `❯` marker inside a trust
 /
 # setup / login dialog is NOT input readiness, and `❯`
 never authenticates the CLI.  Reproduced bug: the
 # first-run trust screen ("Accessing workspace / ❯ 1. Yes,
 I trust this folder / 2. No, exit") was reported
 # as a logged-in input box because it contains `❯`.
 def claude_ui(tail_lines) -> dict:
     return claude_readiness.classify(tail_lines or [])'''
 assert old in s; s = s.replace(old, new, 1)

 old_result = '''    result = {
         'platform': a.platform,'''
 new_result = '''    claude_screen =
 screens['worker-2'].get('screen_lines') or []
     claude = claude_ui(claude_screen)
     claude_gate = claude_readiness.readiness_gate(claude)

     result = {
         'platform': a.platform,'''
 assert old_result in s; s = s.replace(old_result,
 new_result, 1)

 old_pane = """            'claude_pane': {'name':
 'worker-2', 'pane': w2.pane_id, 'cwd': claude_cwd,
                             'tail':
 screens['worker-2']['tail'],
                             'ui':
 claude_ui(screens['worker-2'].get('screen_lines') or
 [])},"""
 new_pane = """            'claude_pane': {'name':
 'worker-2', 'pane': w2.pane_id, 'cwd': claude_cwd,
                             'tail':
 screens['worker-2']['tail'], 'ui': claude,
                             'input_ready':
 claude_gate['input_ready'],
                             'blocked_by':
 claude_gate['blocked_by'],
                             'authentication':
 claude_gate['authentication']},
             # A fixture is ready only on a genuine
 logged-in input box: a pending trust/setup/login dialog
             # (even one that shows `❯`) forces
 fixture_ready=false.
             'claude_input_ready':
 claude_gate['input_ready'],
             'fixture_ready': claude_gate['fixture_ready'],
             'blocked_by': claude_gate['blocked_by'],"""
 assert old_pane in s; s = s.replace(old_pane, new_pane, 1)
 p.write_text(s)

 # ---------------- lifecycle_fixture.py
 q = Path('scripts/acceptance42/lifecycle_fixture.py'); t =
 q.read_text()

 WORK =
 Path('/Users/USER/Documents/Codex/2026-10-30/new-chat/wor
 k/acceptance42')""", 1)

 old_lc = '''LOGIN_MARKERS = ('Select login method', 'Sign
 in with', 'Paste code', 'Log in to Claude', 'Choose a
 theme')
 INPUT_MARKERS = ('❯', 'bypass permissions', 'for
 shortcuts', 'Claude Code v')
 '''
 assert old_lc in t; t = t.replace(old_lc, '', 1)

 old_ui = '''def claude_ui(tails: dict) -> dict:
     text = '\\n'.join('\\n'.join(v) for k, v in
 tails.items() if k.startswith('fx-worker'))
     return {'login_prompt_seen': [m for m in LOGIN_MARKERS
 if m in text],
             'input_box_markers': [m for m in INPUT_MARKERS
 if m in text],
             'logged_in_ui': any(m in text for m in
 INPUT_MARKERS) and not any(m in text for m in
 LOGIN_MARKERS)}'''
 new_ui = '''def claude_ui(tails: dict) -> dict:
     """Worker screens through the SHARED classifier (same
 trust/setup/login rules as setup_fixture)."""
     text = '\\n'.join('\\n'.join(v) for k, v in
 tails.items() if k.startswith('fx-worker'))
     return claude_readiness.classify(text)'''
 assert old_ui in t; t = t.replace(old_ui, new_ui, 1)

 old_ready = """            'claude_logged_in_ui':
 ui['logged_in_ui'],"""
 new_ready = """            'claude_logged_in_ui':
 ui['logged_in_ui'],
             'claude_input_ready': ui['input_ready'],
             'claude_dialog_pending':
 ui['dialog_pending'],"""
 assert old_ready in t; t = t.replace(old_ready, new_ready,
